summary: Contestants demonstrate their knowledge of server administration in a Windows network environment by completing an objective test and, for top finalists, a hands-on component. The event covers tasks such as system configuration, network management, security, and troubleshooting. Any secondary or postsecondary student may participate.
time_limits: Preliminaries - No more than sixty (60) minutes for objective test
Preliminaries (Nationals only) - No more than sixty (60) minutes for objective test, and no more than sixty (60) minutes for performance component
Finals (Nationals only) - No more than sixty (60) minutes for performance component
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials, including hands-on tasks.
(Optional) Cordless calculator: Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards.
competencies: Monitor, manage, and troubleshoot access to files, folders, and shared resources to ensure data security and user productivity
Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows® operating systems, hardware devices, and drivers to ensure compatibility, stability, and reliable deployment
Monitor, analyze, and optimize system performance and implement backup and recovery solutions to ensure reliability and minimize downtime
Implement and manage data encryption, auditing, and security policies in Windows® environments to ensure compliance and protect organizational assets
Configure and manage Azure AD / Entra ID to support secure user authentication, access management, and identity protection in cloud-connected environments
Implement and troubleshoot hybrid identity solutions and Single Sign-On (SSO) to provide seamless, secure access across on-premises and cloud resources
Use Microsoft Intune to enroll, configure, secure, and manage devices through cloud-based policies, ensuring consistent settings and compliance across the organization
Configure and maintain virtualization clusters to provide high availability, load balancing, and resilient performance in virtualized environments
Deploy and manage Active Directory Domain Services and Group Policy, and configure and troubleshoot core network services including DNS and DHCP to support a Windows Server domain environment

Install and configure Windows Server roles and features; administer systems using PowerShell; implement file, storage, backup, and recovery services; apply patch and update management; and deploy Hyper-V and failover clustering for high availability
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed

Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.

The top 10 contestants at Nationals will advance to a final round that includes a hands-on component. Scores from the preliminary round and the objective test will not carry over to the finals. Reference materials may be used during the application portion of the final round.
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this objective event.
